info.title: winche
info.description: The winche command-line tool: validate access rules locally and deploy them to a Winche console, like the Firebase CLI. Install with: dotnet tool install -g Winche.Cli

commands.name: init
commands.description: Create winche.json and starter database.rules / storage.rules

commands.name: login
commands.description: Sign in to the console in your browser (Keycloak)

commands.name: logout
commands.description: Forget the saved sign-in for the console

commands.name: deploy
commands.description: Publish the rules files as new versions on the console

options.name: --console
options.description: Console URL, e.g. https://api.example.com/_console (or WINCHE_CONSOLE, or winche.json)

options.name: --token
options.description: Bearer token to use instead of a saved sign-in (or WINCHE_TOKEN; for CI)

options.name: --config
options.description: winche.json to use (default: the nearest one upward)

options.name: --only
options.description: database, storage, or database,storage (default: every file in winche.json)

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what deploy would change, without saving

options.name: --force
options.description: Deploy even when the console already has these rules

options.name: --stdout
options.description: Print pulled rules instead of writing the files (pull)

options.name: --port
options.description: Loopback port for the sign-in callback (login; default 9005)

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help

options.name: --version
options.description: Show the version
